decisions_taken_from_docs: load @clerk/ui from the Frontend API domain (no new npm dependency)
use the documented 424242 test code for Clerk client-trust verification of +clerk_test users (no bypass)
keep official backend verification with explicit authorized parties (no custom crypto)
note: Official Clerk documentation consulted before the compatibility change; excerpts summarised, not copied.

sources.finding: ClerkJS from npm must load the separate @clerk/ui browser bundle from the instance Frontend API domain (https://<domain>/npm/@clerk/ui@1/dist/ui.browser.js, crossOrigin anonymous) and call clerk.load({ ui: { ClerkUI: window.__internal_ClerkUICtor } }) before mountSignIn; the domain is derived from the publishable key.
sources.title: JavaScript Quickstart

sources.finding: Development instances accept +clerk_test email subaddresses and +1 (XXX) 555-0100..0199 phone numbers; both use the fixed verification code 424242.
sources.title: Test emails and phones

sources.finding: Verifies session tokens from the Authorization header or the __session cookie; authorizedParties checks the azp claim and is strongly recommended; needs jwtKey or secretKey.
sources.title: authenticateRequest()

sources.finding: Session tokens are short-lived JWTs with claims including sub, sid and azp (origin of the frontend request).
sources.title: Session tokens
